inputs.text: Hi, the plastic knob on my gas stove (Whirlpool AKT 8130) cracked and the gas valve shaft now spins freely. Can you print a knob? Also the little clip that holds the grease filter on my range hood broke off.

environment.load: manual turning torque on gas valve shaft

spark.notes: Cannot print gas control knob for safety; obtain OEM knob from Whirlpool/dealer and have valve checked since shaft spins freely. Second item - range-hood grease-filter clip - not entered here; please submit separate request with hood brand/model and photo.

part.failure: cracked and gas valve shaft now spins freely
part.name_user: plastic knob on my gas stove

spark.reason: Gas control part: printed knob can crack, slip or misindicate valve position causing uncontrolled gas release, fire/explosion risk. Requires original manufacturer part.

open.why: Gas valve knob is a gas control - if printed copy cracks, melts or slips the valve can be left open causing gas leak, fire or explosion.
